provenance.title: Conflicting pairs
provenance.covers: Pairs of style tags that clash when used together in one room. Our own common-sense groups, not taken from a source. No open source for taste was found.

sources.name: The Grammar of Ornament (Owen Jones, 1856), a public domain book on colour and pattern, via Project Gutenberg. Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
